item.title: Why Winter Is the Season God Calls Us to Rest
item.description: This winter, embrace nature's cue to rest and rejuvenate instead of chasing the typical "new year, new me" pressure. Discover how aligning with the slower, introspective rhythm of the season can lead to a more grounded and fulfilling year ahead, preparing you for true growth in the spring.

item.title: A Letter to Young Parents from Someone Who's Been There
item.description: We enter our parenting journey with fear, desires, and goals. The ever-present thoughts of all we want to accomplish or don't want to do – things our parents may have done or not done – can sometimes overwhelm us. What I've learned is if we really want to be the parents God wants us to be, we must come to a point where we see the following truths.

item.title: A Prayer for the New Church Plant in Your Town - Your Daily Prayer - February 1
item.description: Just because no one asked doesn’t mean they don’t need help. This prayer invites you to support your local church plant in the most powerful way—by lifting them up to God.
